Hi! I am a researcher interested in analysing education systems through field and online experiments using behavioral economics tools.

Most of all, I like connecting and communicating research and its findings in simple and useful ways, both for people in other fields of research and those not in research at all. I am a firm believer in clear and simple communication for a better future.

This website collects my CV, research projects, academic and professional trajectory, and occasional reflections on topics I like and am interested in.
